intro: StorageCafe has no city statistics page for Allentown. UnitSight's September 2026 street-rate index, from 24 facilities and 398 listings, puts the standard (non-climate) 10x10 at $145. SpareFoot's unspecified average for a 10x10 was $138.34 on September 1, 2026, included here as $138. The advertised rate averages those two published figures. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (UnitSight street rates; SpareFoot 10x10 average). No StorageCafe industry-statistics page; no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page.

units.notes: UnitSight standard (non-climate) street rate $67 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled on the same page ~$64. SpareFoot's unspecified 5x5 average was $57.03 and is not mixed into this size.
UnitSight standard street rate $92 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$93. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

UnitSight standard street rate $145 (Sep 2026), 24 facilities. SpareFoot unspecified average $138.34 on Sep 1, 2026, rounded to $138; that average is not split by climate. Climate-controlled on the UnitSight page ~$142. StorageCafe, StorageUnitCosts, and Storage Stats do not publish an Allentown market page.

local_tips: UnitSight tracks 24 facilities and 398 listings in Allentown (September 2026). Listings without an advertised price are excluded rather than estimated.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
